content.passage: A city introduced protected bicycle lanes on several busy roads after residents raised concerns about safety. Early monitoring shows that more people are cycling on these routes, although some drivers report longer travel times at peak hours. The city will collect data for another six months before deciding whether to expand the network.

answer.illustrative_response: The city introduced protected bicycle lanes to improve safety, and although cycling has increased while some drivers report longer peak-hour trips, officials will collect more data before deciding whether to expand the network.
